summary: Row-wise per-pixel color transformation using four lookup tables. Dual path selected by global rendering-mode flag byte_5D79DC: SIMD path (8-pixel groups via sub_51C813 plus scalar remainder) and a pure scalar path. Each pixel writes 3 output bytes indexed from source channel bytes against lookup tables with a base offset.

local_names.a1: this object with color lookup sub-struct and base values

operations.description: Load v5 = a1[104] (color lookup sub-struct pointer, this+0x1A0), v6 = a1[71] (base value, this+0x11C), v7 = a1[23] (row width, this+0x5C), and the four lookup tables v5[2..5] (this+0x1A8, this+0x1AC, this+0x1B0, this+0x1B4).
Compute v10 = v7 & 0xFFFFFFF8: the row width aligned down to whole 8-pixel SIMD groups.
Branch on rendering-mode flag byte_5D79DC (global): non-zero selects the SIMD+scalar hybrid path, zero selects the pure scalar path.
Both paths require a5-1 >= 0 (row count guard) before processing any row.
SIMD path: iterate over rows while row counter a5 decrements to zero; each row resolves three source plane pointers from a2 plus 4*a3 and advances the output row pointer a4.
SIMD path: call sub_51C813 with the 8-pixel group count v10 and the three plane pointers to process aligned 8-pixel groups.
SIMD path remainder: when the 8-pixel group count v10 is less than the full width v42, process the remaining pixels with a scalar loop.
SIMD-path scalar remainder: per-pixel, read source channel bytes, index lookup tables with the base offset v6, and write three output bytes per pixel.
Scalar path: per-row per-pixel loop gated on width v7 != 0, performing the same three-byte table-indexed color write as the SIMD remainder path.
Return the final result pointer (last pixel/output pointer used). __cdecl ABI as recorded in the legacy ABI lead.
